summary: The failing assertion is correct; the real cause is a rotted locator. Proposing a locator fix rather than removing the check — deleting it would hide a genuine break.

evidence.description: Locator-failure; the assertion itself is valid

proposedChanges: Repair the locator to a role-based getByRole query so the existing assertion can run again.
Keep the welcome-message assertion exactly as-is; it is the check that has value.

rollbackStrategy: Revert the locator change; no assertions were touched.

diffGuardReview.note: Plan only. Removing or skipping the assertion is refused; the guard would fail such a diff.
